text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, we get off at the next station, right? 
And then... the next transfer is... umm...

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Next is the final stop... the final 
stop. Please watch your step as you exit 
the train."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! Before I knew it, I seem to have 
wandered quite far away~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If I take the next train, I'll 
still make it in time for training, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is it~! If I buy a souvenir for our 
training, I'm sure Trainer will be 
delighted~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, station attendant~ Could you 
tell me a good place to buy souvenirs?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Hot spring buns, bath salts, yukatas, and 
tofu skin... There are so many choices, I 
can hardly decide~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We don't have much time either, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"A souvenir for Trainer-sama, who always 
takes such good care of me... I shall 
ensure I pick out the absolute finest 
choice~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright was so obsessed with 
souvenirs that she ended up skipping her 
training.
